Synthetic, from the known risk in PR #35's review. Three search listings and a details-origin one are first seen (the handler queues nothing); details-selector selects the three search listings. Its `enqueue()` is replayed before submit (kept once), the first-seen event and a selection are replayed while the batch is leased (kept once, no second fetch), and both again after the batch closed with full descriptions (skipped). Across all replays each ID is sent to Apify exactly once; only the genuinely new ID 4 gets its own batch. The details-origin listing 9 is never selected and never queued.
